login.heading: Sign in to the Panel
login.invite: You came with an invite: sign in to accept it.

refusal.restart: The sign-in did not finish. Start it again.
refusal.try_later: Telegram or the Panel is not answering now. Try again later.
refusal.refused: Telegram did not confirm who you are.
refusal.defect: The sign-in failed on our side. Tell the Panel's owner.
refusal.foreign_state: This sign-in was started in another browser. Start it again here.
refusal.stranger: You have no access to the Panel. Ask for an invite.
refusal.deactivated: Your access to the Panel is closed.
refusal.invite_invalid: The invite is used, revoked or out of time. Ask for a new one.

error.network: The Panel's API is not reachable.
error.timeout: The Panel's API did not answer in time.

project.archive_confirm: Archiving cannot be undone. Type the project's slug to go on:
project.revoke_admin_confirm: Revoking an admin takes his permissions from all the staff. Type his Telegram id to go on:
project.take_confirm: Taking these permissions from an admin takes them from staff members of the project: {count}. Go on?

invites.heading: Invites
invites.link: The link — it is shown once:

server.type_name: This wipes data. Type the server's name to go on:
server.sure: This is prod. Are you sure?
server.ask_destructive: the project's verb is destructive — confirm by the server's name
server.bad_json: A field is not valid JSON.

run.repeat_from_card: Repeat it from the server's card

add_server.heading: Add a server
add_server.once: The token is shown once: leave this page and it is gone.
add_server.box: A box with the machine and the product installed
add_server.needs: The machine v{release} or newer. An older one: update it by its install.sh.
add_server.step_machine: Install the machine of release v{release}:
add_server.step_product: Install the product by its passport: pridem install
add_server.warning: The token works once and for one hour. Run the command from a root shell; the leading space keeps it out of bash's history. Do not run it with sudo: sudo drops the variable.
add_server.waiting: Waiting for the box to register…
add_server.expired: The token expired: issue a new one.

refusal.token-unknown: the Panel does not know the token
refusal.token-used: the token is used: issue a new one
refusal.token-expired: the token expired: issue a new one
refusal.name-taken: a server of that name exists
refusal.product-mismatch: the box's product is not this project's
refusal.protocol-too-old: the box's machine is too old for the Panel
refusal.protocol-too-new: the box's machine is too new for the Panel

passport.title: Passport
passport.problems: The machine refuses this passport — an edit that passes its checks mends it:
passport.bad_json: The value is not valid: a number or JSON as the field has.
passport.absent: This server has no passport in primer-ops.
passport.not_recipient: The Panel's key does not open this passport. Add the Panel's age key as a recipient of it in primer-ops:
passport.file: This server reads its passport from a file on the box: an edit in the Panel would not reach it.

damaged.sops-damaged: The passport in primer-ops is not a sops file the Panel decrypts: mend it in primer-ops.
damaged.not-a-file: The passport's path in primer-ops is not a file — a link or a directory: mend it in primer-ops.

passport.sure: This is prod. Apply the passport?

rule.keep_releases: 1 removes the directory of the previous release: a rollback fetches its sources again.
